Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat is listed for University of Tartu in an official university AI tools source. Derived availability: allowed. Derived endorsement type: officially endorsed.

University of Tartu guidance treats submitting work created partly or entirely with AI under one's own name, without mentioning and describing AI use, as inconsistent with academic integrity and as academic misconduct under the Study Regulations.

University of Tartu guidance states that lecturers have the right to decide how artificial intelligence is used in their course and, if necessary, to limit or prohibit its use, with instructions given in the course version information or assignment guidance.
The University of Tartu guidance encourages the use of artificial intelligence, including text robots, in teaching, and frames that use around purposeful, ethical, critical, and transparent practice.

University of Tartu guidance says that if personal data or other sensitive information needs to be processed with AI applications, users logging in with a UT account should use AI application versions approved by the university IT department and ensure the application is on an authorized computer.

The University of Tartu IT wiki states that the university has signed a one-year agreement with OpenAI for ChatGPT Education from 5 December 2025 to 5 December 2026, and that at the current stage licenses are offered primarily to employees.
